findings.text: Meta and Google spend are $0 for all 28 days in the window; zero leads generated. Account is completely dark on paid.

⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue as of 2026-08-31; intake bottleneck remains unresolved per SOW.
GBP actions fell -51.61% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 29–31) show 0 actions each, a confirmed 3-day collapse.
Search clicks dropped -10.11% week-over-week; last full day in series (Aug 28) shows 0 sc_clicks, directionally consistent with GBP decline.
